note: OpenAI shipped reasoning-specialized models in 2024H2: o1-preview/o1-mini Sept 12, 2024; full o1 Dec 5, 2024.
GPT-5 did not ship by Dec 15, 2024 (it shipped August 2025).
Anthropic shipped Claude 3.5 Sonnet (June 20, 2024; upgraded Oct 22, 2024) which beat Claude 3 Opus on coding and became a default coding model.
Devin reached general availability Dec 10, 2024 at $500/month.
Copilot Workspace stayed in technical preview through 2024; it never reached GA.
GitHub Copilot went multi-model at Universe (Oct 29, 2024): Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Gemini 1.5 Pro added alongside OpenAI models.
Cursor kept growing through 2024H2: $60M Series A announced Aug 2024 (~$400M valuation) with rapid developer adoption.
Codeium raised a $150M Series C at a $1.25B valuation (Aug 2024) and shipped its own IDE, Windsurf Editor (Nov 13, 2024).
Swift Assist, announced at WWDC June 2024 for 'later this year', had not shipped in Xcode by Dec 15, 2024.
Google shipped a next-generation Gemini before the target date: Gemini 2.0 Flash (experimental) on Dec 11, 2024, pitched at agentic coding use.
No US federal statute restricting code-generation tools passed by December 2024.
Strong open-weight code-capable releases continued in 2024H2: Llama 3.1 405B (July), Codestral Mamba (July), Qwen2.5-Coder 32B (Nov).
Frontier per-token prices kept falling in 2024H2: GPT-4o mini (July, $0.15/M in), GPT-4o cut to $2.50/M in (Aug), Gemini 1.5 price cuts (Aug).
